_note: Schema 2. Every entry names the vendor page it was read from (source_url) and the day it was read (fetched_at); an entry with a lifecycle date or a non-active status and no source is refused by modelpin.models.Model itself. Dates are the vendor's own, transcribed the day the page was fetched, never recalled. Where two Google surfaces publish different dates for one id, the entry carries the Vertex AI lifecycle table's date and quotes the other surface in notes. The OpenAI page's five fine-tuning base-model rows (ft-*) are not transcribed: they are not callable ids. The pre-2026-09-17 placeholders gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.5 were self-declared UNVERIFIED and appear on no fetched page; they were removed rather than sourced. modelpin/watcher/registry.py mirrors the models array; regenerate it with `python scripts/registry_check.py --sync`.
